name: Feferi Peixes
source:
Feferi Peixes, also known by her Trollian handle “cuttlefishCuller”, is one of the trolls. 

She is a sea dweller, and the former heiress to the throne of the Alternian Empire. Of all the trolls, she is the highest on the hemospectrum, and is a radical reformist in that she wishes to make Alternia a nicer place. However, she seems to be misguided, and her ideas are very naive and likely would not work out the way she'd want them to. She does not put on airs of superiority like the blue bloods, and is never shown to be purposely cruel to anyone because of their blood color. Instead, she excites easily, and is perky and energetic when talking to other trolls. She is seen to be eager and almost entirely optimistic and fearless. However, she can also be rather condescending and seems to be masking a slightly rude and insulting side.

Her associated zodiac sign is Pisces. She is of fuschia blood caste, which is the highest rung on the trolls' hemospectrum.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Feferi_Peixes]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
